current_quest: Phase 4b-2 complete. lib/ai/generate-prep.ts now makes a real OpenAI call instead of returning mock JSON. Same signature, same PrepOutput shape. Model: gpt-4o-mini (gpt-5.4-nano per spec is not a real OpenAI model — flagged; swap when 5.x nano lands). QUICK_PREP_MODEL constant exported and used as model_used in app/app/actions.ts (was 'mock-quick-prep'). System prompt is a senior-coach role with explicit anti-boilerplate and stage-aware question rules; quick-tier counts hardcoded (3-5 questions_they_ask, 2-3 questions_you_ask, 3 risks counter=null, 4 frames, 4 checklist items done=false, 3-4 criteria with integer weights ~100). User prompt assembles stage/company/role/interviewer/tier + truncated resume (8K cap), JD (12K cap), latest_message (4K cap). Strict json_schema response_format with hand-written PREP_OUTPUT_JSON_SCHEMA (additionalProperties:false everywhere, nullable union types for counter/answer_plan/interviewer_insights). Falls back to json_object + Zod parse on strict-mode failure; prepOutputSchema.safeParse runs as final defense. For tier=quick, generator force-nulls counter/answer_plan/interviewer_insights post-parse (belt-and-suspenders, since strict mode allows non-null). Stage in output overridden to input.stage to keep staleness detection honest. lib/ai/prep-types.ts now exports zod schemas (prepStageSchema, prepCriterionSchema, prepFrameSchema, prepRiskItemSchema, prepChecklistItemSchema, prepQuestionThemSchema, prepQuestionYouSchema, prepOutputSchema); TS types are z.infer<> derived so existing callers compile unchanged. generatePrepAction wraps generatePrep in try/catch and returns { ok: false, error } on OpenAI failure (UI surfaces existing error state). No cache pre-check before generate — every Generate/Regenerate click is a fresh call, fresh prep_versions row (regenerate is explicit user intent). No rate limits / cooldowns yet (Phase 7). No schema/UI changes. tsc clean. Next: manual verification with real seed jobs (different stages, different JDs, confirm prep references resume + JD specifics, not boilerplate), then 4c Deep Prep + paywall.
